articles.title: Genrobotics signs MoU with Territorial Army for defence, disaster-response robotics
articles.summary: Robotics firm Genrobotics has signed an MoU with the Territorial Army (TA) for collaboration in robotics research, technology evaluation, and capability development. This partnership signifies the Indian armed forces' strategic move towards integrating advanced robotics for modernization and operational efficiency. Aspirants should note this trend of leveraging cutting-edge technology to enhance national defence capabilities and personnel training.

articles.title: Updated Bucky Irving Fantasy Outlook 2026: Bet on the Buccaneers RB Bouncing Back
articles.summary: Bucky Irving, a prominent running back, is preparing for the 2026 season aiming to replicate his successful rookie year. He stands out as one of only four running backs in the past decade to achieve over 1,100 rushing yards, underscoring his significant past accomplishments in the sport and his aspirations for future success.

articles.title: Updated Quinshon Judkins’ Fantasy Outlook 2026: Why the Browns RB Is Priced Too High
articles.summary: Athlete Quinshon Judkins is recovering from a brutal dislocated ankle and fractured fibula, sustained late in his rookie professional season on December 21. As he prepares for his second season, his arduous rehabilitation will be crucial for his future performance and career trajectory. This highlights the significant challenges professional athletes face with major injuries impacting their careers.

articles.title: Nepal floods: Shashi Tharoor writes to S Jaishankar, calls for NDRF contingent, deployment of IAF choppers
articles.summary: With several Indian citizens missing after devastating flash floods in Nepal, Congress MP Shashi Tharoor urged the Modi government to dispatch a full NDRF contingent and heavy-lift helicopters. This underscores India's crucial role in international disaster response, highlighting its commitment to protecting citizens abroad and demonstrating vital humanitarian aid capabilities for national security.
